prerequisites: Strong understanding of the concept of equilibrium in solids.
Proficiency in calculating geometric characteristics of flat areas (center of gravity, static moments, and moments of inertia).
0708302: CÁLCULO DIFERENCIAL E INTEGRAL (Differential and Integral Calculus)
0708301: ALGEBRA LINEAL Y GEOMETRÍA (Linear Algebra and Geometry)

learning_outcomes.text: Apply the principles of strength of materials in the selection of materials used in engineering
Recognize and understand the principles of strength of materials applied to engineering
Recognize and understand the training needs that will be useful to successfully resolve new situations related to industrial engineering
Propose creative solutions to satisfactorily respond to real needs and problems of society
Develop professional texts and scientific-technical reports according to the conventions of the field of industrial technical engineering
Adapt the organization of content and the use of language, verbal and non-verbal, to argue in diverse situations or before diverse audiences
Carry out measurements, calculations, valuations, appraisals, expert reports, studies, reports, work plans and other tasks specific to the field of technical engineering
Apply the knowledge of industrial engineering in learning new methods and theories
Show the advantages and opportunities of different solutions to the same problem critically and constructively
Apply the principles and methods of quality

syllabus_topics: BLOCK I.- GENERALITIES AND PREVIOUS KNOWLEDGE.
BLOCK II.- STUDY OF STRESSES IN STRAIGHT BARS. Isostatic structures

assessment_methods.method: Mixed tests (final exam of the entire subject)
Mixed tests (partial exam of the first block)
Individual assignments (projects, reports, essays, case studies, portfolios, reflective journals, concept maps, etc.)
Delivery of the laboratory practice report
